title: Translated-unit comparison on K-flat cone triangles
statement: Let f:Z→Y be proper between Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with the recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in one localization universe, recorded derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback], and a supplied strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Write c_X(K):O_X[1]⊗K≅K[1] for [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exists a single e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1] such that, for every cochain morphism p:P→Q between K-flat O_Y-complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], with T=Qh.mapTriangle(mappingCone.triangleh p), the triangle with first maps F(T.mor₁), F(T.mor₂) and last map F(T.mor₃) followed by F(c_Y(T.obj₁) inverse), the supplied inverse tensorator δ_(O_Y[1],T.obj₁), e tensor id, and c_Z(F(T.obj₁)) is distinguished in D(O_Z). Only explicit cone triangles of K-flat morphisms are asserted here.

proof.text: Represent O_Y by its degree-zero complex and O_Y[1] by its translate. These are K-flat. Termwise module pullback identifies these complexes with O_Z and O_Z[1]. The derived-pullback comparison on K-flat representatives [def-pc-derived-pullback], together with the supplied monoidal unit map, gives a single e:F(O_Y[1])≅O_Z[1]. This e is chosen before P,Q,p.

For p:P→Q between K-flat complexes, its mapping cone is K-flat by [lem-pc-kflat-closure]. The K-flat counit in [def-pc-derived-pullback] is invertible on P,Q and the cone. The additive termwise module-pullback functor identifies the pulled-back cone, its inclusion and its projection with the cone triangle of the pulled-back morphism, using CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapTrianglehIso.

Write the degree-one translation as tensor with O_Y[1] by [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. In the cone projection comparison, the resulting map is F(c_Y(P) inverse), then the supplied inverse tensorator, then e tensor id, then c_Z(F(P)). Substitute the first-variable Koszul comparison and the shifted left unitor defining c. Naturality of the tensorator moves the cone projection through it; tensorator associativity and its unit equations give the stated normalization. Thus the displayed triangle is isomorphic to the localized termwise-pullback cone triangle and is distinguished. This step includes the compatibility for the supplied monoidal structure; exactness for an unspecified shift alone does not establish it.

theorem exists_derivedPullback_translatedUnit_kFlat_cones
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)] :
    ∃ e : (derivedPullback f).obj ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Z))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (p : P ⟶ Q),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) Q →
        let Qh : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
            schemeDerivedCategory Y := DerivedCategory.Qh
        let T := Qh.mapTriangle.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangleh p)
        Triangle.mk ((derivedPullback f).map T.mor₁) ((derivedPullback f).map T.mor₂)
          ((derivedPullback f).map T.mor₃ ≫
            ((derivedPullback f).mapIso (schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Y T.obj₁).symm ≪≫
              asIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (derivedPullback f)
                ((𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) T.obj₁) ≪≫
              tensorIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
              schemeCanonicalShiftUnitIso Z ((derivedPullback f).obj T.obj₁)).hom) ∈
          distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Z)
